Problem Statement:
A heap can be represented as an array as it is a complete binary tree. The element at heap[i] is the parent of heap[2
i] andheap[2
i + 1]. (i >= 1). Determine if a given array is a min-heap, max-heap or neither. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an Integer N denoting the number of citizens.The next line contains N space separated integers A[i] (1 
Output Description:
If the given array is a min-heap print MINIf the given array is a max-heap print MAXPrint NONE if it is neither. 
Explanation:
A[1] has children at A[2] and A[3]. A[1] < A[2] and A[1] < A[3].Hence A[] is in min-heap form.

3
1 2 3
